name: Cryonic-Shoal
description: Cold has crystallized everything here into geometry: dune-fields of frost, canyons of clear blue ice, and far off, past an orbital debris ring, a light that lingers blue long after sunset.

Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound. Carpet-flora blooms all at once after each rare rain, turning whole basins scarlet overnight.
Nothing about the radiation hotspot appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
Whoever solves this anomaly will rewrite several sciences. Whoever blunders into it will merely end several careers.
